Nowledg"},{"id":"p3s2","text":"e Mem brings DSH into the same durable memory system as your other agents, with startup context, pro"},{"id":"p3s3","text":"mpt-time recall, MCP memory tools, and turn-end thread capture."},{"id":"p4s1","text":"This repository is the canonical standalone plugin package, mirrored in `nowledge-co/community` for "},{"id":"p4s2","text":"the Nowledge Mem connector index."},{"id":"p5s1","text":"## Install"},{"id":"p6s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"For a local checkout of `nowledge-co/community`, run this from the repository root:"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"Make sure the `nmem` CLI is on `PATH`, then verify:"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"The adapter supports DSH 0.1.5-rc.2, 0.1.7-rc.1, 0.2.1-alpha.1, and 0.2.1-rc.2. It uses
`shell.execu"},{"id":"p11s2","text":"te(...).result()` on current hosts and retains the legacy
`shell.run()` fallback. Injected messages "},{"id":"p11s3","text":"use `source.kind: "plugin:nowledge-mem"`,
matching DSH's v3-to-v4 migration; existing legacy snapsho"},{"id":"p11s4","text":"ts are still recognized.
Restart DSH after replacing an installed plugin version."},{"id":"p12s1","text":"The bundle connects to the local Mem MCP endpoint by default:"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"For Nowledge Cloud or another remote Mem, set:"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"## What It Does"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"- Injects the Nowledge Mem Context Bundle once per DSH session through `agent/pre-step`.
- Runs prom"},{"id":"p17s2","text":"pt-time memory recall for continuation, release, regression, connector, plugin, and other recall-sha"},{"id":"p17s3","text":"ped prompts.
- Adds the Mem MCP server through DSH's reconnecting `@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client`, so "},{"id":"p17s4","text":"tools appear as `mcp__nowledge_mem__...`.
- Imports the real DSH surface transcript after completed "},{"id":"p17s5","text":"turns with `nmem t import --source deepseek-harness`.
- Stamps CLI imports with `NMEM_IMPORT_ORIGIN="},{"id":"p17s6","text":" import --source deepseek-harness`.
- Stamps CLI imports with `NMEM_IMPORT_ORIGIN=deepseek-harness`."},{"id":"p18s1","text":"## Configuration"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"The bundle accepts these row config fields in a later `cordis.patch.yml` override:"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p21s1","text":"Ambient variables also work:"},{"id":"p22s1","text":"- `NMEM_SPACE`
- `NMEM_AGENT_ID`
- `NMEM_HOST_AGENT_ID`
- `NMEM_MCP_URL` or `NOWLEDGE_MEM_MCP_URL`
-"},{"id":"p22s2","text":"- `NMEM_AGENT_ID`
- `NMEM_HOST_AGENT_ID`
- `NMEM_MCP_URL` or `NOWLEDGE_MEM_MCP_URL`
- `NMEM_API_KEY`"},{"id":"p23s1","text":"## Model Experience"},{"id":"p24s1","text":"### Startup Context"},{"id":"p25s1","text":"The model sees one plugin-sourced user message containing the current Nowledge Mem Context Bundle. I"},{"id":"p25s2","text":"t is marked as `form: "snapshot"` and reminds the model that it is cross-tool context, not an instru"},{"id":"p25s3","text":"`form: "snapshot"` and reminds the model that it is cross-tool context, not an instruction override."},{"id":"p26s1","text":"### Prompt-Time Recall"},{"id":"p27s1","text":"When the user asks to continue, remember, review previous work, ship a release, debug a regression, "},{"id":"p27s2","text":"or discuss connectors/plugins, the plugin calls:"},{"id":"p28s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p29s1","text":"The model sees a bounded recall message with memory titles, source hints, scores, and content."},{"id":"p30s1","text":"### MCP Tools"},{"id":"p31s1","text":"Mem MCP tools are registered through DSH's MCP bridge under the `nowledge_mem` namespace. DSH curren"},{"id":"p31s2","text":"tly bridges MCP tools only; MCP resources and prompts are not surfaced by the Harness client."},{"id":"p32s1","text":"### Thread Capture"},{"id":"p33s1","text":"After each completed DSH turn, the plugin imports human input and assistant
reply text into Mem as `"},{"id":"p33s2","text":"source=deepseek-harness`. DSH marks actual user input
with `source.kind: "user"`; user-role context "},{"id":"p33s3","text":"from other producers (runtime,
clock, skills, Mem or other plugins) is not a human prompt. Assistant"},{"id":"p33s4","text":" steps
containing tool calls, including their intermediate narration, tool results,
reasoning blocks"},{"id":"p33s5","text":" and execution metadata are not conversation text and are not
stored as Thread messages. Image block"},{"id":"p33s6","text":"s retain an attachment placeholder, not
image bytes. Visible text is preserved verbatim within the c"},{"id":"p33s7","text":"onfigured size cap;
the plugin does not summarize or rewrite answers."},{"id":"p34s1","text":"Updating the plugin changes future captures; it does not delete or rewrite
previously imported noisy"},{"id":"p34s2","text":" messages. Stable identities still prevent new copies
of unchanged conversation messages. Reopening "},{"id":"p34s3","text":"an older polluted session may
report an import conflict if an existing message with the same identit"},{"id":"p34s4","text":"y contains
execution text: do not delete the Thread or change its identity to force a
retry. Review "},{"id":"p34s5","text":"a scoped cleanup/export with support first. New sessions can be
used to verify the updated capture w"},{"id":"p34s6","text":"ithout touching old data."},{"id":"p35s1","text":"### Sandbox Compatibility Retry"},{"id":"p36s1","text":"The plugin does not retry a sandbox-unavailable `nmem` command with
`danger-full-access` by default."},{"id":"p36s2","text":" An operator who explicitly accepts that wider
access may set `allowDangerFullAccessRetry: true` in "},{"id":"p36s3","text":"the `nowledge-mem` plugin
config. Even with that opt-in, the retry runs only when the DSH host provi"},{"id":"p36s4","text":"des
`ctx.sandboxPolicy` and resolves the requested policy; otherwise it fails
closed and logs why th"},{"id":"p36s5","text":"e retry was skipped."},{"id":"p37s1","text":"## Known Limitations"},{"id":"p38s1","text":"- DeepSeek Harness is in developer preview, so public package APIs may change.
- Historical DSH sess"},{"id":"p38s2","text":"ions are not backfilled by this package yet; it captures new sessions while the plugin is active.
- "},{"id":"p38s3","text":"The DSH MCP bridge exposes tools only, so Nowledge Mem resources/prompts are not shown through MCP t"},{"id":"p38s4","text":"oday.
- Turn capture depends on the local `nmem` CLI being available in the DSH process environment."},{"id":"p39s1","text":"## Community Position"},{"id":"p40s1","text":"The canonical public repository is `nowledge-co/nowledge-mem-deepseek-harness`, tagged with `dsh-plu"},{"id":"p40s2","text":"gin` for DeepSeek Harness ecosystem discovery. The `community` repository keeps a registry/index mir"},{"id":"p40s3","text":"ror for Nowledge Mem surfaces."},{"id":"p41s1","text":"## Development"},{"id":"p42s1","text":"Install development dependencies before running the regression suite:"},{"id":"p43s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p44s1","text":"The plugin tests exercise the entry point with DSH 0.2.1-alpha.1's real message
and Session implemen"},{"id":"p44s2","text":"tations and validate context and recall in both durable
user-message and inbox-splice rows using the"},{"id":"p44s3","text":" official v4 admission validator.
CLI responses and shell execution are deterministic test doubles; "},{"id":"p44s4","text":"a live DSH
and Mem smoke test is still required to verify an installed release."},{"id":"p45s1","text":"GitHub Actions runs ESLint and tests on every pull request and push to `main`.
The test matrix cover"},{"id":"p45s2","text":"s Ubuntu and Windows with Node.js 24 and DSH 0.1.7-rc.1,
0.2.1-alpha.1, and 0.2.1-rc.2. It also chec"},{"id":"p45s3","text":"ks the npm package contents with `npm pack --dry-run`."}],"truncated":false}
